data.content: The authors of this 1825 memorial,
and

, were prominent Qing dynasty scholar-officials whose intersecting administrative careers in Fujian made them central figures in the maritime frontier's governance. As vital primary sources for establishing the historical record of Taiwan's sovereign administration prior to 1895, both men brought extensive bureaucratic experience to the region's challenges.

earned his prestigious Jinshi degree in 1796 after passing the Palace Examination. He spent his early career serving as an investigating and supervising censor across Shandong, Fujian, and Beijing, later moving into executive roles as a provincial treasurer and governor in Guangdong and Guangxi. At the time this memorial was drafted, Zhao was serving as the Governor-General of the Min-Zhe region (a post he held from 1822 to 1825), giving him ultimate civil and military oversight of Fujian and Taiwan just prior to his transfer to the Yun-Gui region.
Co-author

similarly followed the traditional scholarly route, securing his Jinshi degree in 1805. Unlike Zhao, Sun possessed a deep, localized resume within Fujian itself long before ascending to the highest regional offices. Beginning in 1814, he served successively as the Prefect of Tingzhou, the Fujian Salt Commissioner, and the Provincial Treasurer. This hands-on experience—particularly his oversight of the provincial salt administration—gave him direct insight into the illicit salt trades and vagrant populations addressed in their joint memorial. Sun served as the Governor of Fujian from 1823 to 1825 and, following Zhao's reassignment, was immediately promoted to succeed him as the Governor-General of Min-Zhe, where he continued shaping Taiwan's administrative integration until 1832.
Memorial on the Investigation and Management of Village Clearing in Taiwan (5th Year of Daoguang [1825])
查辦臺灣清莊事宜疏（道光五年）
by
and
趙慎畛、孫爾準
Governor-General of Fujian and Zhejiang, Zhao Shenzhen, and Governor of Fujian, Sun Erzhun, humbly kneel and memorialize
regarding the various matters of conducting village clearings and suppressing smuggling in Taiwan.
閩浙總督臣趙慎畛、福建巡撫臣孫爾準跪奏，
爲查辦臺灣清莊緝私各事宜事。
It is humbly observed that Taiwan lies isolated beyond the sea, with a population that has no indigenous roots and customs that are by nature frivolous and unstable.

There have long been vagrant drifters from the mainland who secretly cross over without authorization. Such idle and aimless persons possess no trade to rely on, nor any land to cultivate. Having developed habits of laziness, even when employed as laborers they cannot endure hardship. They either conceal themselves in gambling houses or lurk in petty thievery. Drifting about in a foreign place, they are beyond effective registration or control. There is concern that their numbers will gradually increase, forming groups and factions, and when local conditions are peaceful, they will freely carry out robbery, bringing harm to the common people.
竊照臺灣孤懸海外，民無土著，俗本輕浮，素有內地遊民，偷越私渡，
此等遊手好閒之人，既無藝業可守，又無田地可耕，且懶惰性成，即傭工力作，亦復不耐辛勞，非匿跡於賭場，即潛蹤於鼠竊，異鄉飄泊，無可稽查，恐漸聚漸多，成羣結黨，當地方無事之時，肆行搶劫，爲害閭閻，

The people of the Taiwan prefecture are mostly from Zhangzhou and Quanzhou, known for their combative nature; whenever minor disputes arise, these vagrants take the opportunity to join in, aggravating the violence. At minor levels, this incites armed brawls; at major levels, it leads to treasonous plotting. Last year, when the southern rebels Xu Shang and Yang Liangbin gathered mobs to cause trouble, we suspected vagrants were inciting them from within. Fortunately, the local commanders, intendants, and prefects handled the matter swiftly, annihilating the ringleaders and their accomplices. However,
mainland vagrants have not yet been completely eradicated, and it is urgent to investigate, expel, and clear them out as a plan for long-term stability.
而臺郡率皆漳泉民人，素尚忿爭，一遇雀角微嫌，該遊民等即乘機附和，助勢逞兇，小則激成械鬥，大則謀爲不軌。上年南路匪徒許尚、楊良斌等，糾衆滋事，即恐有遊民從中煽誘。幸該鎮道府等拏辦妥速，當將首夥各犯，殲除殆盡。但
內地遊民，尚未絕跡，亟須查逐清釐，以爲久安之計。

However, to investigate and expel vagrants, there is no better method than the 'village clearing' approach, which is simpler and easier to implement than the Baojia registration system. The year before last, due to urgent policing needs in Yanping and Jianning prefectures, we instructed subordinates to make minor modifications beyond the Baojia system by implementing joint guarantees, which proved quite effective. Village clearing is similar to joint guarantees. Last year, when Sun Erzun went to Taiwan, he also ordered Taiwanese subordinates to vigorously implement the village clearing method, prohibiting the harboring of criminals. This has been previously memorialized for Imperial review during the inspections of shed people and the re-examination of the Baojia system.
然欲查逐遊民，莫善於清莊一法，其事較編查保甲，尤爲簡而易行。前年臣等因延平、建寧等郡捕務緊要，曾飭各屬於保甲之外，小爲變通，辦理連甲，頗有成效。清莊亦與聯甲相仿。上年臣孫爾準赴臺時，亦飭臺屬力行清莊之法，毋許容留匪類，均於稽察棚民複查保甲案內，先後奏蒙聖鑑在案。

Because the people of Taiwan originally came from Zhangzhou, Quanzhou, and Guangdong, they live separately in different villages. Each village has a headman, and all villagers submit to his authority.
We have accordingly ordered the Taiwan Circuit Intendant and Prefect
to supervise and instruct the sub-prefectures and counties, requiring these headmen to take responsibility—together with guest leaders and village elders, as well as village chiefs and Baojia heads—
to carry out thorough investigations. If there are unfamiliar or suspicious individuals
—or those drifting without fixed residence at old temples, pavilions, or rest stops—
and upon investigation they are found to have no relatives to rely on, then they are to be classified as vagrants.
緣臺灣向系漳、泉、粵三籍之人，分莊居住，各莊設有頭人，莊民鹹聽頭人管束。
臣等見覆分飭臺灣鎮道府，
督飭廳縣，責成該頭人，率同客長鄉耆，並莊正、保正人等，
實力查察。如有面生可疑，
或在古廟涼亭及飯歇處所飄流無定之人，
查無親屬相依者，既屬外來遊民。

The headmen must immediately report them to local officials, investigate their mainland origins, and per regulations, expel them across the sea. The characters for 'crossed the water' will be tattooed on their faces, and they will be escorted back to their hometowns for settlement, never allowed to smuggle themselves to Taiwan again.

Even those who enlist as porters at transport agencies must be verified by the agency heads; if they are found to be honest, law-abiding, and peaceful citizens, a guarantee bond shall be issued, and they will be permitted to remain and work in the guild. However, if their background is suspicious, or if they are aggressive, prone to fighting, or known to cause trouble, they must be reported to the relevant governing officials and summarily driven back to their home provinces.
該頭人等立即稟報地方官，訊明內地籍貫，照例逐令過水，面刺過水二字，遞迴原籍安插，毋許復行偷渡赴臺；
即在夫行投充小夫者，亦令夫頭查明，果系良民誠實安分者，出具保結，仍準在行充夫，如來歷不明，及好勇鬥很，動輒生事之徒，亦俱報明本管官，一律驅逐回籍。

As the headmen clear their respective villages, making the policy known to every household, there is neither the disturbance of chaotic searches by clerks and runners nor the complexity of door placards and registers. Since the villagers are protecting their own homes, they are also willing to engage in this. Once the sub-prefectures and counties in Taiwan receive reports from the headmen, they will immediately interrogate the subjects, first placing the vagrants under strict custody. Whether in small groups or dozens, they will be escorted back to the mainland in batches,
該頭人等，各清各莊，家喻戶曉，既無胥役紛查之擾，又無門牌冊籍之繁。各莊民自衛自家，亦樂於從事。臺地各廳縣，一據頭人稟報，立時訊明，先將該遊民嚴加看管，或數人或數十人，分起押解回內，

Because the ocean voyage is dangerous, they must be securely managed and escorted, with regulations drafted to prevent them from causing trouble or escaping midway. Once they arrive at the mainland ports, local officials will escort them stage by stage. Orders have also been issued to the prefectures, sub-prefectures, and counties of Quanzhou and Zhangzhou that whenever deported vagrants from Taiwan arrive, they must instruct the local elders and clan heads of their respective hometowns to secure guarantees and strictly control them, not allowing them to travel out without permission,
海洋險阻，必須妥爲管解，亦令議立章程，以免中途滋事疏脫，俟解至內地入口，即由地方官逐程遞解，並通飭泉州、漳州各府廳縣，如遇臺灣遞解遊民到境，按照籍貫，飭命該處鄉耆族房取保，嚴行管束，毋許私自外出，

Simultaneously, orders shall be dispatched to civil and military officials in the mainland and Taiwan, strictly enjoining officers guarding the ports to conduct rigorous interrogations of all vessels entering or leaving. Should any nefarious subjects be found crossing the Taiwan Strait illegally, both the individuals and their vessels are to be seized and brought to justice. By maintaining such strict inspections, vagrants will be prevented from sneaking into Taiwan, thereby ensuring the peace and tranquility of the region.
一面分檄內地，臺灣該管各文武，嚴飭守口員弁，凡遇船隻出入口者，務須實力盤詰。如有奸民越渡臺洋，即將人船拏解究辦。似此稽查嚴密，庶遊民不能溷跡赴臺，地方獲就安謐。

Regarding the salt administration in Taiwan Prefecture, it has traditionally been handled by licensed merchants who hire their own patrolmen for inspection. We have heard that treacherous people along the coast have illegally set up salt pans to dry and sell salt on their own, with the situation being especially severe within Jiayi County. These outlaws illegally drying salt are precisely these vagrants. If they are not investigated and arrested early, they will gather over time and become a detriment to the land,
至臺灣府鹽務，向由販戶承辦，自行選僱哨捕巡緝，見聞該處沿海奸民，私設埕坎，擅自曬鹽販賣，惟嘉義縣境內爲尤甚。此等曬私匪類，即系遊民，若不及早查拏，日久嘯聚，亦足爲土地之害，

We have already urgently dispatched orders to the Taiwan intendants and prefects to direct the sub-prefectures and counties to select capable runners to cooperate with the licensed merchants in strict patrols. They are to arrest and prosecute the illegal salt producers everywhere, so that private smuggling is restrained and official salt sells smoothly. This will not only ensure that tax revenues and the people's food supply face no risk of shortage but also leave the ruffians and vagrants with no place to rely on for a livelihood. Consequently, treacherous individuals from the mainland will shrink back in fear upon hearing the news and dare not proceed there again, allowing Taiwan to be thoroughly cleansed. This is truly of great benefit to this crucial overseas region.
業經飛飭臺灣道府，督飭廳縣，選派幹役，協同販戶，嚴緊查緝，將各處私曬匪徒，拏獲解究，俾私販斂戢，官引暢銷，不特課賦民食，無短絀匱乏之虞，且令匪棍流民，無托足謀生之所，則內地奸徒，聞風畏縮，不敢再行前往，而臺地得以一律肅清，實於海外要區，大有裨益。

However, separated by the deep ocean, Taiwan is not as easily monitored as the mainland. We fear that the sub-prefectures and counties, being far from the provincial capital, might harbor intentions of negligence. We are currently conducting secret investigations and have issued strict directives to these sub-prefectures and counties. If they earnestly investigate the vagrants in their jurisdictions and completely expel them, ensuring the civilians are not burdened, they will be considered officials who genuinely perform their duties and will definitely be appropriately rewarded.
惟臺灣重洋間隔，非如內地之耳目易周，恐該廳縣以距省窵遠，意存泄玩，臣等見在密加訪察，並嚴札通飭該廳縣等，如將境內遊民人等，認真細查，押逐淨盡，使民間不受擾累，即系實心任事之員，定當量予獎勵。

If they fail to enforce the orders vigorously, whether due to laziness or limited capabilities, and fail to completely eradicate them despite conducting searches, or if they do not intensify their searches and fail to follow through, they are unfit for the responsibilities of the maritime frontier. They should be immediately recalled to the mainland, either reassigned to less demanding posts or demoted to subordinate positions, handled according to the severity of the case and reported to the throne. If they outwardly comply but secretly disobey, or shrink from difficulties for the sake of temporary peace, completely ignoring the matter, they are bringing ruin upon themselves and will be immediately strictly impeached as a warning to others.
如奉行不力，或由於辦事懈怠，或限於才質迂疏，雖經查逐，未能悉數驅除，即不加緊搜查，有初鮮終，亦難勝海疆之任，應即撤回內地，或改補簡缺，或降補佐雜，分別輕重，奏明辦理。若竟陽奉陰違，或畏難苟安，膜置不辦，則自甘暴棄，立即嚴參示儆。

By setting such rewards and punishments, ensuring that all sub-prefectures and counties are motivated and vigilant, we can hope to achieve tangible results. We continue to order the military commanders, intendants, and prefects to conduct thorough local investigations and truthfully report at any time, without showing the slightest favoritism, to avoid incurring heavy blame. Considering the critical importance of the maritime frontier, we respectfully submit this memorial, humbly begging Your Majesty's sagacious review and instruction.
如此酌定勸懲，使各廳縣，共知奮興警懼，方可冀收實效，仍令該鎮道府，就近確查，隨時據實稟報，毋得稍事徇護，並乾重咎。臣等爲海疆地方緊要起見，謹恭折具奏，伏乞皇上聖鑑訓示。
